resources.string: Change your voice in Discord and other call apps.
Real-time voice changer for the microphone of Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram and other call apps.
Apps you enabled in LSPosed hear your changed voice. Voice and slider changes apply instantly, even during a call.
Changing your voice inside another app\'s call needs a rooted phone with LSPosed. Without it you can still test voices and record clips below. See \"How to use\".
Use headphones to hear yourself without feedback. Record a clip and share it to Discord as a voice message or file. Works without root.
How to use in Discord calls

Android doesn't let normal apps change the microphone of other apps, so live voice changing in calls needs root:

1. Root your phone with Magisk (or KernelSU / APatch).
2. Install LSPosed (Zygisk version).
3. Open LSPosed → Modules → enable "V1 Voice Changer".
4. In its scope, tick Discord (and any other call apps).
5. Force-stop Discord (or reboot), then open this app.
6. Turn on "Change my voice in calls" and pick a voice.
7. Join a Discord call. Your friends hear the changed voice. You can switch voices during the call.

Works with apps that capture the mic through Android's AudioRecord: Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger and most other VoIP apps. Normal phone-network (SIM) calls are handled by the modem, so they can't be changed this way.

No root? Use "Record clip" and share the clip to Discord as a file or voice message.
